veld.open_verbinding: Suspected open connection or short circuit
veld.veiligheid_bevestigd: Circuit is de-energised and capacitor is safely discharged

veiligheid.waarschuwing_1: Never measure on a circuit that is still under voltage.
veiligheid.waarschuwing_2: Verify the absence of voltage with a suitable measuring instrument.
veiligheid.waarschuwing_3: Discharge the capacitor in a controlled manner.
veiligheid.waarschuwing_4: Large capacitors can build up voltage again over time.
veiligheid.waarschuwing_6: When in doubt, disconnect at least one terminal.
veiligheid.waarschuwing_7: An LCR measurement does not automatically test leakage current, insulation, or breakdown voltage.
veiligheid.waarschuwing_8: A good ESR value does not prove the capacitor is safe at its rated voltage.
veiligheid.waarschuwing_9: This app is not a formal safety clearance.
veiligheid.frequentie_wijkt_af: Reference frequency differs from the measurement frequency — no automatic conversion performed.
veiligheid.in_circuit: Measurement was taken in-circuit; the result is less reliable.
veiligheid.eenhedenfout: Strong indication of a unit error in C, ESR, or D — check the entered values.
veiligheid.one_leg: Measurement with one terminal disconnected; more reliable than fully in-circuit, but still context-dependent.
veiligheid.referentietype_wijkt_af: The reference capacitor type differs from the component being assessed.
veiligheid.buiten_bereik: The meter indicates an out-of-range/OL value; numerical assessment is not reliable.

consistentie.sterke_aanwijzing_eenhedenfout: strong indication of a unit error

capaciteit.tolerantie_onbekend: Tolerance unknown; capacitance cannot be assessed.

esr.referentie_ongeldig: Reference value is invalid (≤ 0); ESR cannot be assessed.
esr.frequentie_waarschuwing: Note: measured at {meetfrequentie:.0f} Hz, reference applies to {referentiefrequentie:.0f} Hz — no automatic conversion performed.

consistentie.geen_d: No D value entered; consistency check not performed.
consistentie.ongeldige_invoer: Capacitance or frequency invalid; consistency check not performed.
consistentie.niet_positief: Expected or measured ESR is ≤ 0; consistency check not meaningful.
consistentie.consistent: Measured ESR ({esr_gemeten:.4g} Ω) matches the ESR expected from D ({esr_verwacht:.4g} Ω) within a margin of {marge:.1f}×.
consistentie.mogelijke_inconsistentie: Measured ESR ({esr_gemeten:.4g} Ω) deviates {factor:.1f}× from the ESR expected from D ({esr_verwacht:.4g} Ω) — possibly a mΩ/Ω mix-up, wrong frequency, or rounding. No automatic correction applied.
consistentie.sterke_aanwijzing: Measured ESR deviates {factor:.0f}× from the ESR expected from D — strong indication of a unit error (e.g. mF instead of µF). Check the entered values.

betrouwbaarheid_factor.referentiefrequentie_wijkt_af: reference frequency differs from the measurement frequency
betrouwbaarheid_factor.typisch_niet_maximaal: reference value is a typical value, not a maximum
betrouwbaarheid_factor.mogelijke_inconsistentie: possible inconsistency between C, ESR, and D flagged
betrouwbaarheid_factor.one_leg: one terminal disconnected: reliability capped at medium
betrouwbaarheid_factor.referentietype_wijkt_af: reference type differs from capacitor type

eindstatus_reden.invoer_onvolledig: Input incomplete or no measurement started.
eindstatus_reden.open_verbinding_vermoed: Open connection or short circuit suspected.
eindstatus_reden.meerdere_criteria: Multiple independent criteria indicate a defect:
eindstatus_reden.geen_striktere_regel: None of the stricter rules clearly applied; conservatively assessed as a point of attention.
eindstatus_reden.buiten_bereik: At least one measurement is outside the instrument range or displayed as OL.

eindstatus_vervolgstap.vul_aan_of_bevestig: Complete the missing information or confirm the safety steps before further assessment.
eindstatus_vervolgstap.vervang_component: Replace the component; do not use further without additional investigation.
eindstatus_vervolgstap.vervang_of_bevestig: Replace the capacitor or confirm with a second, independent measurement.
eindstatus_vervolgstap.vergelijk_of_ontkoppel: Compare with an identical new unit or disconnect one terminal for a more accurate measurement.
eindstatus_vervolgstap.herhaal_meting: Repeat the measurement if possible with a more reliable reference or setup.
eindstatus_vervolgstap.geen_actie: No further action needed; keep monitoring periodically if this is a critical component.
eindstatus_vervolgstap.controleer_meetbereik: Check the measurement range, connections and instrument settings, then repeat the measurement.

meetmethode.uitleg_ex_situ: Most reliable setup: component fully isolated from the circuit.
meetmethode.uitleg_one_leg: Good practical intermediate setup: most parallel paths are interrupted.
meetmethode.uitleg_in_circuit: Indicative measurement: parallel components can affect capacitance and ESR.

tooltip.buiten_bereik: Use when the meter displays OL, overrange or under-range.
tooltip.veiligheid_bevestigen: Tick this box only after verifying that the circuit is de-energised and the capacitor has been safely discharged.
tooltip.tolerantie_standaard: Default suggestion ±20% for aluminium electrolytic capacitors. Use the actual datasheet value when known.
